profile.reading: DC10 is a building on Data4 Italia own MIL01 campus in Cornaredo, near Milan, Italy, which Data4 own page addresses at Via Monzoro 101-105, 20007 Cornaredo (MI), Italy. Data4 describes the MIL01 campus overall as 20 hectares with 170 MW of total electrical capacity, published only at the site level, so no building specific MW or square footage figure is attributed to this record. This registry separately lists seven other DC and DCL numbered buildings on the same campus.
profile.capacity_note: Campus level total published, 170 MW and 20 hectares, not broken down per building, so no per building MW or square footage figure is recorded.
